Method of Attack: Stored Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) vulnerability allowing remote unauthenticated attackers to execute JavaScript code stored in the database of WordPress websites in visitors' browsers
Injection of malicious JavaScript code into social share links on site posts
Redirecting visitors of compromised websites to malicious sites and tracking activity via cookies
Impacted Systems: WordPress websites using Social Warfare plugin versions 3.5.1 and 3.5.2
Attack Vector: Exploitation of stored XSS vulnerability in Social Warfare plugin
Repository URL: WordPress plugin store (removed and later restored after patch)
Indicators of Compromise: Malicious JavaScript code injected into social share links
Redirects to malicious sites including pornography and tech support scams
Tracking of visitor activity via cookies
